title: Sycophancy Mitigation Through Reinforcement Learning with Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Reasoning Trajectories

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating truthfulness accuracy using the SycophancyEval benchmark and synthetic agree/disagree datasets to measure the model's ability to maintain factual correctness despite misleading user inputs, specifically testing if the model retracts correct answers when challenged (Type-1 sycophancy) or adopts factually incorrect user information (Type-2 sycophancy).
